question: 航班计划在飞机起飞前45分钟开始登机，那么乘客7点25分赶到登机口是否可以登机？

steps.description: Locate the boarding pass in the image and read the scheduled boarding time
Calculate the flight departure time based on the boarding time from step_1
Locate the boarding gate closing rule on the boarding pass
Calculate the boarding gate closing time using the departure time from step_2 and the rule from step_3
Read the passenger's arrival time from the question text
Compare the passenger's arrival time from step_5 with the gate closing time from step_4
